component.name: Convert the Spire Reborn
component.summary: Play and download music and videos

description.p: A music and video player that also fills your library: download songs, videos and whole playlists from more than 1,800 sites, open torrents and magnet links, and convert files to the format you need.

The player has subtitles, lyrics, loops of the part you want and a large view. Compare checks a playlist against your folder and fetches only the songs you are missing, and watched playlists keep themselves up to date.
A built-in browser with Chrome and Firefox extensions, casting to a TV and a layout that works with a TV remote complete it. It is available in 18 languages.

The mouse wheel scrolls web pages in the browser again, and the arrow keys move the remote-control cursor even after a page was clicked. The remote's OK clicks like a real mouse click, where the cursor is. The app has a new icon.
The browser works on Linux, with Chromium inside the app, and Chrome and Firefox extensions add to web pages here too. Scrolling with a TV remote now works on every page.
